description: This Java source file defines the UtilDateTime class, which provides a comprehensive set of date and time utility methods for parsing, formatting, manipulating, and converting java.util.Date, java.sql.Date, java.sql.Timestamp, and java.sql.Time objects. It handles time zone and locale-specific operations, date arithmetic, and static constants related to date/time formats.

classes.name: UtilDateTime
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for date/time parsing, formatting, arithmetic, and conversions with support for locales and time zones.
